name: Table of Contents
description: Builds a linked table of contents from the h2 and h3 headings of a page, gives every heading an anchor id, and puts it at the top of the article, boxed or as a sticky sidebar. No JavaScript.

panels.title: Table of contents
panels.description: The list of sections shown at the top of long pages on this site. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show a table of contents
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: min-headings
fields.title: Minimum number of headings
fields.description: Pages with fewer listed headings get no table of contents. 3 by default.

fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Shown above the list. "On this page" by default.

choices.title: Box at the top of the article

fields.name: numbered
fields.title: Number the sections
fields.description: 1, 2, 3 for sections and a, b, c for subsections. Off by default.

fields.name: accent
fields.title: Accent colour
fields.description: The side rule and the hover colour. Leave empty to use the text colour of the page.

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Pages to skip
fields.description: Slugs, separated by commas, that never get a table of contents. For example: home, contact
